remarks: AVAILABLE 7/1/26. If you're looking for a cool space, you've found it! This stylish two-story loft, formerly a commercial building offers 1032 square feet, character and upgrades in the heart of SONO! 1-year young floors, new sleek black-stainless steel washer/dryer and refrigerator, exposed brick, soaring 11-ft ceilings, and skylights that flood the home with natural light. Enjoy the convenience of in-unit laundry, central air, gas heat, free parking, and a spacious walk-in closet. Plus, unwind in the beautiful fire pit terrace. The best part? Step outside, and you're just across the street from the AMC theater and an array of top restaurants and bars!  Requirements: Credit score of 680+ and income must be 3x the rent no exceptions. Owner/agent.  Owner pays water, sewer, grounds maintenance and snow removal. Tenant pays for renter's insurance, electric and gas. Minimum 1 year lease term. See included floor plans***Brand new black-stainless steel washer, dryer, and refrigerator not shown in pictures***
